title.narrative: Transformational Climate-smart and Inclusive Agriculture

description.narrative: The Action intends to consolidate the transition to socially and environmentally inclusive agri-food systems, including the improvement of inclusive agriculture value chains targeting local, regional and international markets. In line with Rwandas economic development, emissions profile and climate vulnerability, climate adaptation measures in the agricultural sector will be promoted, whilst enhancing climate and biodiversity benefits. Gender equality is a significant objective of the Action an
